svg.title: Faultline architecture
svg.desc: On one machine, the CLI submits jobs and requests snapshots from a coordinator at 127.0.0.1:9000. The coordinator owns the FIFO queue, job state, and worker registry. Each worker connects independently, registers for an ID, receives assignments, reports job progress and outcomes, and sends a heartbeat every two seconds by default. Six seconds of heartbeat silence expires an assignment. The coordinator appends and syncs its local write-ahead log before acknowledging submissions, dispatching assignments, or publishing accepted results, and replays the log at startup.
